en:
## Bug Fixes

- Relaxed overly strict Zod schema constraints on agent tools (Read, Terminal, Agent, Overseer) so that slightly imprecise model outputs (floats, zero, negative numbers) are gracefully coerced instead of rejected
- Added missing `args` field to Skill tool Zod schema so skill arguments are no longer silently dropped
- Added missing `alias` field to Agent tool Zod schema to match the advertised rawJsonSchema
- Added missing `allowedPrompts` field to ExitPlanMode Zod schema to match the advertised rawJsonSchema

## Refactoring

- Extracted background subagent completion queue into a standalone module to eliminate circular dependency
zh-CN:
## 修复

- 放宽 Agent 工具（Read、Terminal、Agent、Overseer）过严的 Zod schema 约束，模型输出的浮点数、零值、负数等边界值现在会被自动修正而非直接拒绝
- Skill 工具补充缺失的 `args` 字段到 Zod schema，技能参数不再被静默丢弃
- Agent 工具补充缺失的 `alias` 字段到 Zod schema，与 rawJsonSchema 保持一致
- ExitPlanMode 补充缺失的 `allowedPrompts` 字段到 Zod schema，与 rawJsonSchema 保持一致

## 重构

- 将后台子代理完成队列提取为独立模块，消除循环依赖
